Title: Resolve test mode from the Apps Script web-app URL
Problem / Request: The dashboard runs inside an Apps Script sandbox, so location.search inside the frame did not retain the outer ?mode=test parameter. Resolve the outer URL with google.script.url.getLocation before booting the dashboard.
Acceptance Criteria: Opening the isolated deployment with ?mode=test visibly shows TEST MODE · NO WRITES, renders deterministic fixture data, and performs no runtime server-function, GPS, or Sheet-write calls. Opening without mode=test remains normal. GitHub Actions must pass; no merge or deployment occurs automatically.
